definitions.gloss: used bookstore; secondhand bookshop; antiquarian bookshop
definitions.explanation: A store that sells used, secondhand, or rare and antique books. More formal and literary than the everyday term.

examples.japanese: {古書店|こしょてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a rare book at a used bookstore.

examples.japanese: {神保町|じんぼうちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{古書店|こしょてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Many used bookstores line the streets of Jinbocho.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{古書店|こしょてん}をめぐって、{絶版|ぜっぱん}になった⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧だ。
examples.english: My hobby is visiting used bookstores on weekends to look for out-of-print novels.

notes:
A more formal or literary term for a used bookstore. {神保町|じんぼうちょう} in Tokyo is famous as Japan's largest district of {古書店|こしょてん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古書店|こしょてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めぐる — to visit used bookstores
- {古書店|こしょてん}{街|がい} — used bookstore district
- {古書店|こしょてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ — to buy at a used bookstore

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{古本屋|ふるほんや}→古本屋：16329_furuhonya⟧ — used bookstore; the everyday, casual equivalent
- ⟦{書店|しょてん}→書店：04205_shoten⟧ — bookstore (general, new books)
- ⟦{本屋|ほんや}→本屋：03034_honya⟧ — bookstore; casual everyday term
